title: Spawn Distance
description: Tiny HUD with 3D distance and a directional arrow back to your world spawn — handy when you wander far from base and want a quick way home.
body:
**Spawn Distance** adds a small, unobtrusive HUD in the top-left corner that shows you the **3D distance** to your world spawn point, together with a **directional arrow** that rotates with your view. When you wander deep into caves, far across the seas, or get lost during night-time exploration, one glance at the HUD tells you both how far home is and which way to walk.

### Features

- **3D distance** to world spawn (including elevation difference), displayed in meters and switching to kilometers once you cross 1 km.
- **Compass arrow** that always points back to spawn from your current facing direction — eight cardinal/intercardinal arrows (`up uright right dright down dleft left uleft`).
- **Dimension-aware**: in the Nether or the End the HUD says "in Overworld" instead of guessing nonsense coordinates.
- **Toggle** with the `O` key (single press).
- **Client-side only** — works on any vanilla server, no server install required, doesn't touch gameplay or world data.
- Cross-version: one JAR runs on **Minecraft 1.21.8 -> 1.21.11** on Fabric.

### Why use it

Vanilla gives you `F3` for coordinates, but no quick "how far is home" answer without arithmetic. Dedicated minimaps are overkill if you only want one landmark. Spawn Distance is a single line of HUD text with a directional arrow — minimal, unobtrusive, and exactly enough information to navigate back to base.

### Controls

- `O` — toggle the HUD on / off

### Compatibility

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11
- **Mod loader**: Fabric (>=0.16.0)
- **Fabric API**: required
- **Side**: client (server install not required)
